lines.t: (Verse 1)
Blood in the gutters, red in the rain,
Nations trading children for a little more gain.
Skies over cities heavy with smoke,
Hearts made of iron, every promise a joke.You build your empires on the bones of the weak,
Call murder “a right” and convenience “unique.”
You crown your idols on a digital throne,
But the cry of the innocent reaches the One who owns it all alone.(Pre-Chorus 1)
You say you’re “free” while you dance in the fire,
Sing about love with a heart full of wire.
Paint holy names on your towers of pride,
But the storm you’ve invited is already outside.(Chorus 1)
Hear the trumpet—wrath in the sound,
Heaven is shaking the unfaithful ground.
Still it’s a mercy call, fierce and alive,
“Turn while there’s time, choose Me and survive.”
Judgment is roaring like a lion’s breath,
Love is the hand pulling you back from death.(Verse 2)
The earth is groaning, roots soaked in greed,
Forests of hatred bearing poisonous seed.
Oceans are rising over coastal gold,
Strong men trembling as their kingdoms fold.You curse what is good, bless what is vile,
Crush the afflicted with a corporate smile.
You mock the days that were meant for rest,
Then blame the Most High when you reap unrest.(Pre-Chorus 2)
You quote holy words then deny the Voice,
Use “grace” as a weapon to sanctify choice.
Reject the Law yet demand the crown,
But every tall tower’s about to come down.(Chorus 2)
Hear the trumpet—war in the air,
Every hidden motive is laid out bare.
Still in the cracking of stone and steel,
A wounded heart is pleading, “Come and be healed.”
The cup of fury is close to the brim,
But the door of the Ark is still open to Him.(Bridge – Spoken to Roar)
This generation kisses the grave,
Sells its own soul just to feel brave.
But the blood still speaks, the tears still fall,
An arm still stretches to rescue all.Storehouses of thunder primed in the sky,
Cities of idols learning how to cry.
Yet there is a shelter no flame can consume,
A narrow doorway beyond the tomb.(Quiet Break – Lament)
Why run to the screen when the cross is near?
Why drown in noise just to mute your fear?
A heart is breaking for a world gone numb,
But the song won’t end till the lost ones come.(Chorus 3 – Final)
Hear the trumpet—mercy in the roar,
Last call pounding on Babylon’s door.
“Come out, come out,” from the neon shame,
Wash your life in a higher Name.
Soon sky will burn and mountains will flee,
But the meek will rise and walk with Me.(Outro)
Trumpet of wrath, river of light,
Pounding like a war drum deep in the night.
If you can hear it, fall to your knees,
Before the last tear falls and the shaking seas.
